title: Power Apps: speech as an input source for form fill assistance in model-driven apps
summary: The briefing agrees with the roadmap's speech-input plan, default and target date. Microsoft Learn supports the general form fill controls, toolbar API and user licensing requirements; the briefing distinguishes these from speech-specific details that remain undocumented.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to expand form fill assistance in Power Apps model-driven apps to accept speech as a source.
claims.quote: We’re expanding form fill assistance in Power Apps to use speech as a source, providing users a more natural way to fill forms.

claims.claim: Users select a microphone icon to record their content.
claims.quote: Users select the microphone icon, record their content

claims.claim: Files are a currently documented source for form fill suggestions.

claims.claim: Storage of the speech-source transcript is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill assistance" "transcript"; form fill assistance speech input transcript storage retention audio processing microphone permissions speech switch. Opened form-filling-assistance and faq-from-filling-assistance; neither describes speech transcript storage.

claims.claim: Retention of the speech-source transcript is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: form fill assistance speech input transcript storage retention audio processing microphone permissions speech switch; "form fill assistance" "transcript". Opened form-filling-assistance and faq-from-filling-assistance; no speech transcript retention passage.

claims.claim: The speech processing architecture for this feature is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: form fill assistance speech input transcript storage retention audio processing microphone permissions speech switch. Opened form-filling-assistance and its responsible AI FAQ; Azure Speech results do not establish this feature's architecture.

claims.claim: Microphone permission requirements for this speech feature are not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: form fill assistance speech input transcript storage retention audio processing microphone permissions speech switch. Opened form-filling-assistance and its FAQ. Results about Windows speech APIs do not identify the permissions used by this feature.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Form fill assistance in a Power Apps model-driven app requires a Power Apps premium licence.
claims.quote: Power Apps model-driven app: The user must have a Power Apps premium license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Form fill assistance in a Dynamics 365 model-driven app requires a Dynamics 365 enterprise or premium licence.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365 model-driven app: The user must have a Dynamics 365 enterprise or premium license as outlined in Dynamics 365 License Guide.

claims.claim: Entitlement is based on the user's licence, as represented by the per-user model.
claims.quote: The form fill assistance requires specific user licenses based on the product. If the user doesn't have the license, the feature is hidden.

claims.claim: The feature is hidden from users without the required licence.
claims.quote: If the user doesn't have the license, the feature is hidden.

claims.claim: Licence enforcement gradually rolls out following the feature's general availability.
claims.quote: This license enforcement gradually rolls out following the feature's general availability.

claims.claim: An additional speech-specific meter or charge is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps form fill assistance speech licensing meter credits pricing. Opened form-filling-assistance; read pay-as-you-go-meters and Power Platform licensing FAQ search excerpts. No result states an additional speech-source meter or charge.

claims.claim: Form fill assistance usage may be subject to service limits.
claims.quote: Usage might be subject to service limits or throttling. Microsoft reserves the right to update the limits.

claims.claim: The column must allow form fill assistance for suggestions to occur.
claims.quote: The Allow form fill assistance column property enabled for the column where form fill assistance occurs.

claims.claim: The current in-app supported field types are text, numeric, choice and date.
claims.quote: The currently supported field types inside apps are text, numeric, choice, and date.

claims.claim: Learn marks the underlying form fill feature as production ready preview in Power Apps.
claims.quote: This feature is in production ready preview in Power Apps.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The environment form fill control is under Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Data entry.
claims.quote: The primary admin control for form fill assistance is moving to the Power Platform admin center under Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Data entry.

claims.claim: An API for the Data entry admin control is not documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Data entry" "form fill" "API" "settings"; "Data entry" "Power Platform API" settings; "form fill assistance" "PowerShell" "pac". Opened form fill, client API and Copilot hub pages; environment-management search results identify no Data entry setting key.

claims.claim: The move to the Data entry admin control is gradually rolling out.
claims.quote: This change is gradually rolling out.

claims.claim: Selecting a Copilot hub setting opens a panel to select the environment and Edit setting.
claims.quote: When you select a setting, a panel opens where you can select your environment or group, select Edit setting, and configure the control.

claims.claim: The per-app toolbar control is in the Power Apps app designer under Settings > Features > Form fill assist toolbar.
claims.quote: In the app designer select Settings on the command bar. ... select Features to enable or disable model-driven app features for the app. ... Form fill assist toolbar. When enabled, the form fill assist toolbar is visible at the top of a form

claims.claim: saveSettingValue("FormFileUploadEnabled", value, {overrideScope: 2, solutionUniqueName: mySolutionName}) updates the current app's form fill toolbar setting.
claims.quote: Xrm.Utility.getGlobalContext().saveSettingValue(settingName, value, saveSettingOptions).then(successCallback, errorCallback); ... Use 2 to add or update a setting app value.

claims.claim: App designer setting changes require saving and publishing the app.
claims.quote: You must select Publish to activate an app settings change. ... Save and Publish the app.

claims.claim: FormFileUploadEnabled is the toolbar setting and FormPredictSmartPasteEnabled is the separate Smart paste setting.
claims.quote: You can previously find Smart paste (FormPredictSmartPasteEnabled) and form fill assist toolbar (FormFileUploadEnabled) app settings in Power Platform admin center

claims.where: controls[2].ui; controls[2].api; Open questions; Governance controls
claims.claim: A separate speech-specific switch is not yet documented on either the UI or automation surface.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill" "speech" "control"; "Power Apps" "speech" "form" "assistance"; form fill assistance speech input transcript storage retention audio processing microphone permissions speech switch. Opened form fill, app settings, client API and Copilot hub pages; no speech switch.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not yet documented which existing form fill controls govern the planned speech source specifically.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill" "speech" "control"; "Power Apps" "speech" "form" "assistance". Opened form-filling-assistance, app-properties, Copilot hub and settings-features. They describe current general controls, but do not describe the planned speech source or its control mapping.

claims.claim: The feature settings reference lists legacy environment form fill settings that are being removed from that page.
claims.quote: Admin controls for the AI form fill assistance feature are changing. ... The following settings are removed from the Environment > Settings > Features page.

claims.claim: Allow form fill assistance is a documented column-level control for current form fill suggestions.
claims.quote: The Allow form fill assistance column property enabled for the column where form fill assistance occurs.

claims.claim: The behaviour of Allow form fill assistance specifically for the planned speech input is not yet confirmed in the documentation.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps speech form fill assistance Allow form fill assistance column control. Read form-filling-assistance and create-edit-field-portal search excerpts: they define the current column control but do not describe speech input.
